name: Card repository conformance across backends
purpose: One conformance case set through the CardRepository port on the filesystem, embedded Qdrant and Quest API (fake card API) backends: roundtrip, overwrite, no loss at volume and across pages, no duplicate, delete (also after restart), concurrent writers, restart, change stamp, tolerance. Every case must hold on every backend Every backend must pass the same conformance cases, so none is better than another when it conforms. A Qdrant server and the live Quest API are not driven, and the fake follows the documented contract.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of the live implementation on the rule's cases, recorded as a row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash; a rule holds or does not, so the implementations are never ranked and a deliberately broken baseline must fail the same cases.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the quest_api offline arm of persist_cards runs the whole case set with no model call] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read: esoi run persist_cards --impl filesystem --only PCD-001 --max-calls 0]

name: Staleness detection precision and recall over mutation cases
purpose: precision and recall over synthetic mutation cases, zero model calls An edit that restores the mtime and size is trusted as unchanged, a deliberate speed trade for the mtime fast path.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the store_sha256 offline arm of staleness runs the whole case set with no model call] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read: esoi run staleness --impl store_sha256 --only STL-001 --max-calls 0]

name: Outage resilience of the card repository
purpose: Offline cases on the live QuestApiCardRepository against an in-process card API that can go down: caller-visible behaviour, stored listing, failed-write outbox, cold start during an outage The shipped null cache and an in-process double lose the listing and the outbox, and the file cache is single-host, so a card backend shared by several hosts has no shared cache.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the file_cache offline arm of cache_cards runs the whole case set with no model call]

name: Cards per source-file group and duplicate share after a repair of an inflated store
purpose: Measures, offline, whether a repair brings a card store that already inflated back to one card per distinct topic of its source files without losing what a person or a run wrote, on the card_growth fixture stores (inflated the way copy mode inflated real ones, with a taught card, a managed card, a card a person wrote with no provenance, a note a run added to a compounded copy and two distinct topics of one file). The repository_tidy arm loads each store into a backend-shaped repository in memory and applies the tidy as a lane with card_tidy = apply does; the quarantine_tool arm runs the script with --apply; the no_cleanup arm is the floor. The local-folder tidy at open has no arm of its own and is read through the bootstrap_guards arm of card_growth. Read in this direction: lower cards per group toward one and the duplicate share toward none, with no group lost and nothing a person or a run wrote lost.
record: Per case: cards before and after, distinct groups, cards per group, duplicate share, groups lost, whether the cards a repair must leave alone remain and whether a run's note is still held; a case passes with one card per group, no group lost, every protected card kept and the note kept. One row per arm per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the cases hash, with no model call.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the repository_tidy offline arm of card_growth runs the whole case set with no model call]
command: esoi run card_growth --impl repository_tidy; esoi run card_growth --impl quarantine_tool; esoi run card_growth --impl no_cleanup
